name: Protect Item
effect: Keep 1 extra item if you die

name: Sap Warrior
effect: Drains 10% of enemy Attack, Strength and Defence, increasing to 20% over time.

name: Sap Ranger
effect: Drains 10% of enemy Ranged and Defence, increasing to 20% over time.

name: Sap Mage
effect: Drains 10% of enemy Magic and Defence, increasing to 20% over time.

name: Sap Spirit
effect: Drains enemy special attack energy.

name: Berserker
effect: Boosted stats last 15% longer

name: Deflect Summoning
effect: Reduces damage dealt from Summoning scrolls, prevents the use of a familiar's special attack, and can deflect some of the damage back to the attacker.

name: Deflect Magic
effect: Protects against magical attacks and can deflect some of the damage back to the attacker.

name: Deflect Missiles
effect: Protects against ranged attacks and can deflect some of the damage back to the attacker.

name: Deflect Melee
effect: Protects against melee attacks and can deflect some of the damage back to the attacker.

name: Leech Attack
effect: Boosts Attack by 5%, increasing to 10% over time, while draining enemy Attack by 10%, increasing to 25% over time.

name: Leech Ranged
effect: Boosts Ranged by 5%, increasing to 10% over time, while draining enemy Ranged by 10%, increasing to 25% over time.

name: Leech Magic
effect: Boosts Magic by 5%, increasing to 10% over time, while draining enemy Magic by 10%, increasing to 25% over time.

name: Leech Defence
effect: Boosts Defence by 5%, increasing to 10% over time, while draining enemy Defence by 10%, increasing to 25% over time.

name: Leech Strength
effect: Boosts Strength by 5%, increasing to 10% over time, while draining enemy Strength by 10%, increasing to 25% over time.

name: Leech Energy
effect: Drains enemy run energy, while increasing your own

name: Leech Special Attack
effect: Drains enemy special attack energy, while increasing your own

name: Wrath
effect: Inflicts damage to nearby targets if you die

name: Soul Split
effect: 1/4 of damage dealt is also removed from opponent's Prayer and added to your Hitpoints

name: Turmoil
effect: Increases Attack and Defence by 15%, plus 15% of enemy's level, and Strength by 23%, plus 10% of enemy's level.
